footnote_text: Common Stock rows reflect the open-ended discretionary stock purchase program previously disclosed for Dr. Ahmed Jamaloodeen. Actual purchases were made over time at prevailing market prices on OTC Markets and/or through private purchases from other shareholders. The 05/20/2026 row is not intended to identify a single purchase made only on 05/20/2026; it reports, in aggregate, the cumulative additional shares acquired after the 04/07/2026 ownership report and through 05/20/2026. The Shares Owned Following Transaction column states the total beneficial ownership as of the ending date shown.
